sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the service of "and you shall serve Havayah your Elokim" relates to both the encompassing light and the essence of Ein Sof, which is above even Havayah.

translations.translation: And one may add,
that from that which is written "and you shall serve Havayah"
(your Elokim)
it is understood that the service
(the avodah)
is not only for the sake of Elokim,
the light that fills,
but also for Havayah,
the encompassing light.
And to add,
that according to what the Ramban said
that the Torah was written in the style of the "Third Person Speaker"
[like "and Havayah spoke to Moshe"],
and it is known that the "Third Person Speaker" is the Essence of Ein Sof, which is above even Havayah,
it can be said,
that this that the commandment "and you shall serve Havayah" is the "Third Person Speaker" is because the matter of service also pertains to the Essence of Ein Sof.
And accordingly, the explanation of "and you shall serve Havayah your Elokim" is,
that through "and you shall serve,"
subjugation,
the revelation of Havayah is drawn down,
the encompassing light.
And the drawing down of the revelation of Havayah is in inwardness,
to the extent that Havayah is your Elokim,
as your wisdom and your life-force,
the unification of the encompassing and the filling.
And through this, the revelation of the Essence of Ein Sof is also drawn down
(the "Third Person Speaker")
which is above even Havayah
(the encompassing).
And it can be said,
that Havayah, which is in the category of revelation, except that it is above the world,
is, in general terms, the light before the contraction that shone in revelation,
and the "Third Person Speaker" which is above Havayah is
(in general terms)
the essence of the light that, even before the contraction, was not in revelation.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that through the service of subjugation, which goes against one's nature, one draws down revelations that are beyond the natural order, including the light that is above revelation.

translations.translation: And the explanation of the matter
(that through the service of subjugation,
changing one's habit and nature,
the revelation of Havayah and also the revelation of the aspect of the "Third Person Speaker" are drawn down)
can be said according to what is stated in the teachings of the Mitteler Rebbe mentioned above in the explanation of the verse
("And upon the likeness of the throne, a likeness")
"as the appearance of a man,"
that the Holy One, blessed be He, is like a mirror of a man,
as is aroused in him
(in the man)
so is aroused with Him, blessed be He,
[and as it is written,
"Havayah is your shadow,"
that Havayah is like your shadow].
Therefore,
by a person forcing himself to act against his will and nature,
the drawing down of the revelations from above is not according to their nature.
That even the light whose revelation, by virtue of its "nature," is before the contraction
(above worlds),
shines in the world,
and moreover,
that even the light which, by virtue of its "nature," is above revelation
(even above revelation before the contraction)
is drawn into revelation in the world.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section raises the question of how the world, which is the opposite of the primordial light, can receive such lofty revelations without being nullified.

translations.translation: Yod)
A)
Now, the above matter is an explanation of how revelations are drawn down into the world.
But it is necessary to understand how the world can receive sublime revelations that are infinitely above it without being nullified from its existence.
And even more so it is not understood,
that the existence of the worlds and the revelation of the light before the contraction
(even the revelation of the light that would fill the void)
are two opposites,
as is understood from the fact that the coming into being of the existence of the worlds is specifically through the removal of the light,
and how can they receive the revelation of the light that preceded the contraction.
